articles.title: Hackers Use New BlackX Bootkit to Bypass Windows Secure Boot on Fully Patched Systems
articles.summary:
A new UEFI bootkit called BlackX has been used in cyberespionage attacks against diplomatic organizations in Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan. The malware targets Secure Boot, a feature designed to help stop untrusted software from running before Windows starts. articles.title: Oracle Issues Emergency Java Update for Critical 9.1 HTTPS Trust Vulnerability
articles.summary:
Oracle has released an emergency Java security update to address CVE-2026-91403, a critical vulnerability affecting how Java applications trust digital certificates. Published on October 21, 2026, the alert assigns the flaw a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.1 and covers Oracle Java SE and GraalVM. The update blocks affected intermediate certificate authority certificates linked to eMudhra. […]
